import control as ct

w=np.logspace(-2,3,601)
G=ct.tf([10,10],[.01,.25,1,0])
mag,phase,omega=ct.frequency_response(G,w)
assert np.ptp(phase)>1
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(7,5),sharex=True)

 h=ct.evalfr(G,1j*q); print('Bode example',q,abs(h),20*np.log10(abs(h)),np.angle(h,deg=True))
for q in [.1,1,10]:

notebooks.title: 二阶频时指标
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import control as ct
from scipy import signal
from scipy.optimize import brentq, minimize_scalar
from scipy.linalg import expm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("python-control", ct.__version__)

cells.code:
def step_value(z,t):
 A=np.array([[0.,1.],[-1.,-2*z]]);B=np.array([0.,1.]);return float((np.linalg.solve(A,(expm(A*t)-np.eye(2)))@B)[0])
for z in [.3,.5,.707,1]:
 end=np.pi/np.sqrt(1-z*z) if z<1 else 20
 tr=brentq(lambda t:step_value(z,t)-.9,0,end)-brentq(lambda t:step_value(z,t)-.1,0,end)
 wb=brentq(lambda w:abs(1/((1j*w)**2+2*z*1j*w+1))**2-.5,0,4)
 L=ct.tf([1],[1,2*z,0]);gm,pm,wpc,wgc=ct.margin(L)
 mr=1/(2*z*np.sqrt(1-z*z)) if z<1/np.sqrt(2) else 1
 mp=100*np.exp(-np.pi*z/np.sqrt(1-z*z)) if z<1 else 0
 print('z,tr*wn,wb/wn,product,Mr,Mr dB,MP%,PM,wc/wn:',z,tr,wb,tr*wb,mr,20*np.log10(mr),mp,pm,wgc)
for target in [30,45,60,75]:
 z=brentq(lambda z:ct.margin(ct.tf([1],[1,2*z,0]))[1]-target,.01,2)
 print('PM to exact zeta and MP',target,z,100*np.exp(-np.pi*z/np.sqrt(1-z*z)) if z<1 else 0)
print('default z=.5,wn=8:',ct.frequency_response(ct.tf([64],[1,8,64]),[8])[0],ct.frequency_response(ct.tf([64],[1,8,64]),[8])[1]*180/np.pi)

notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import control as ct
from scipy import signal
from scipy.optimize import brentq, minimize_scalar
from scipy.linalg import expm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("python-control", ct.__version__)

cells.code:
for w in [.1,1,2,5]:
 base=-90-np.degrees(np.arctan(w))
 print('w, base, exact, Pade (deg)',w,base,base-np.degrees(.5*w),base-2*np.degrees(np.arctan(.25*w)))
for k in [.5,1,5]:
 wc=brentq(lambda w:w*np.sqrt(1+w*w)-k,1e-10,10)
 edge=np.arctan(1/wc)/wc
 pade=ct.tf([-k*.25,k],[.25,1.25,1,0]);poles=ct.poles(ct.feedback(pade))
 print('K,wc,exact delay limit, exact PM at tau .5,Pade poles',k,wc,edge,np.degrees(np.arctan(1/wc)-.5*wc),poles)
 assert (edge>.5)==bool(np.max(poles.real)<0)
print('For this family each crossing moves roots into RHP as delay increases; first limit is the strict stability edge, equality excluded.')
